title: Payment pods OOMKilled after memory change
customerImpact: Intermittent 502 on POST /api/v1/payments when payment-service pods restart in baypay-prod

gates.label: Open the incident
gates.instruction: Read this timeline and the describe paste before requesting events.

gates.label: After first hypothesis

gates.label: After next investigation
gates.instruction: Open JVM flags only after you write what heap versus cgroup would confirm or refute.

events.name: Sam Okada
events.summary: Right-sized payment-service memory in baypay-prod to 512Mi. Set JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS so the heap 'uses the limit'. Ticket BAYPAY-10022. Same class of change as the Module 8 canary, different estate.

events.name: Priya Nair
events.summary: Noted restart count 2 in 50 minutes. Asked for describe and events before raising the limit again.
SEV-2: payment-service baypay-prod unavailable 3 times in 90 minutes. Ingress 502 burst.
Harbor Market: Avery Chen payment c1002b22-0000-4000-8000-111111111002 HTTP 502 then HTTP 201 on retry. Same Idempotency-Key.

events.name: Riley Okonkwo
events.summary: Requested describe (gate 1). Asked Sam not to set -Xmx equal to a new limit without a headroom number.
